a message from fr timothy: my dear parishioners & friends, it is my hope thaty are all fine and doing well. after the short illness and sad loss of my mother, i want to send a message of thanks to you all. although i have been far away from mill town & listry during these past weeks, the parish team have been keeping me updated and telling me about the many people who have been praying for me and my family, asking after us, and passing on their good wishes. i know so many of you have remem bered my mother, teresia, in your prayers and mass intentions and for that i am deeply grateful. hearing all this while being thousands of miles away has been a grea t comfort to me and my family during this difficult time. i will remain in kenya until after my mother's mont h's mind mass and will return on the evening of thursday, 12th november . while it is important for me to spend this time with my family, i very much miss parish life a nd look forward to being back with you all again soon. as we approach the month of november, i ask you to remember my mother, teresia, and especially all our deceased parishioners in your prayers. november is a time when we remember with love and gratitude those who have gone before us and entrust them to god's mercy. be assured that i am r emembering you all and your families in my prayers each day here in kenya. thank you again for your kindness, friendship, and support. i look forward to seeing you all when i return. every blessing, fr. timothy change of time for the milltown annual masses of remembrance 2026 : our annual masses of remembrance for all parishioners who have died during the past year will take place on the following dates. please note the change of time for the milltown mass: milltown | friday, 6th november at 7:30 p.m. listry | saturday, 7th november at 6:00 p.m. university hospital kerry annual mass for the dead: the annual mass for the dead, remembering all who have died in university hos pital kerry during the past year, will take place on: monday, 2nd november at 7.00pm at st. john's church, tralee. all are most welcome. recovery haven free 6-week online course: building better caregivers, shirley bowers on the forgotten irish of barbados | milltown monthly prayer meeting: a very warm invitation is extended to all, not jus t members of the prayer group, to join the milltown prayer meeting on sunday, 1st november , from 8:00 p.m. to 9:30 p.m. in nagle’s rice hall, millto wn. we are delighted to welcome shirley bowers, who will share the story of ministry among the descendants of irish people who were exiled during cromwellian period and sent to barbados. for many of us, this is a little-known ch apter of irish history, and one that has faded from our memory. please come along and bring a friend. everyone is welcome.

collections: offertory €1,255, 2nd collection for the missions € 270. thank you. baptisms: saturday afternoons only from 1pm to 3pm. baptism forms must be returned with a copy of the child’s birth cert. at least a week before the baptism, to the parish office to have the baptism registered. funerals may be recorded, please contact fr. brendan/maria in parish office recordings will be deleted after a month and cannot be retrieved once deleted. eucharistic adoration church of the assumption moyvane tues. 10.30am-11.30am

by 12 noon weds , limited space available. rosary, corpus christi church knockanure sunday 9am before mass in october please note the earlier time for mass on saturday 24th oct. at 7pm. gentle reminder; clocks go back an hour on saturday 24th october at 1am. during november all masses will include those on the november list of the dead. please return lists as soon as possible. spare envelopes and lists at the back of the church. lists can also be returned in the november offerings envelope. november remembrance masses for all who died in the parish since last nov. moyvane tues. 17th nov.’26 at 7pm. knockanure weds. 18th nov.’26 at 7pm. university hospital kerry invites you, your families and loved ones to the annual november mass for all those who have died within the hospital over the past year, including those who have died in palliative care services, maternity services, relatives of hospital staff & former staff members. the mass for the dead will be celebrated mon. 2nd nov. 7pm st john’s church, castle st., tralee. mass live streamed churchservices.tv/tralee or stjohns.ie other notices; moyvane youth club annual church gate collection in moyvane and knockanure 24th & 25th october. any donations would be greatly appreciated. moyvane village festival bh weekend oct. 22nd - 26th. a great weekend of festive fun moyvane village hub in conjunction with the north kerry branch of kerry hospice wish to thank most sincerely everybody who contributed and supported the recent coffee morning, €1 ,500 collected. moyvane village hub knit and stitch group every thursday 10am-12noon. tutor mary cummins. crochet, embroidery, knitting. all very welcome. also celebrate woodland walk sunday 11.30am short video/talk, tea & walk moyvane village hub open 3pm-5pm during the village fest. rambling house. church gate collection for murhur national school will take place sat. 31st oct, at 7.30pm mass in moyvane church and sunday 1st nov. at 9.30am mass in knockanure church. thank you for your support, murhur ns parent's assoc. knockanure parents assoc. agm thurs. 12th nov. 8pm in the school. all parents are warmly invited to attend, meet other parents, share ideas and help shape the year ahead. your support and involvement are greatly valued as we continue to work together for our school and community. everyone welcome! fuchsia café morning tues. 27th oct. and the last tuesday of each month thereafter at the listowel arms hotel. a welcoming space for those with dementia, their carers & families. enjoy a free cuppa, music, quizzes and craic and to meet new friends. for info contact
